name: Pixel It
tagline: Photo to pixel art on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
description:
A photo becomes pixel art on this computer. Take a still or open a picture — nothing is sent anywhere. Drag the block size, tick greyscale, or snap the colours to a palette. Hold the picture to see the original.

The last picture and the last recipe live in the app file. Close it, open it later, they are still here. There is no account.

This is a converter, not a drawing app: you start from a photo. An unofficial port of Pixel It by giventofly.
